phrases.latin: Ubi satur sum, nūlla crepitant; quandō ēsuriō, tum crepant.
phrases.english: When I’m full, my insides don’t rumble at all; when I’m hungry, then they rumble.

phrases.latin: exāctō contentus tempore vītā cēdat utī convīva satur
phrases.english: content with the time he has had, let him leave life like a guest who has eaten his fill

phrases.latin: Satur sum, mamma; nihil amplius volō.
phrases.english: I’m full, Mum; I don’t want any more.

sources: Lewis & Short: satur
